item.title: High-grade hits widen Gilmore's southern gold-copper zone, LNQ reports
item.description: Linq Minerals extends Gilmore Dam gold-copper zone with 144m at 1.0 g/t AuEq; signs of high-grade, 300m strike, drilling next month.

item.title: Green Technology Metals receives extended LOI for financing of Seymour lithium project
item.description: Green Technology Metals secures extended LOI from EDC for up to $107m financing of Seymour lithium project in Canada amid improving lithium market.

item.title: Hydrix secures $2.5m deal to collaborate on development of SynCardia’s total artificial heart technology
item.description: Hydrix secures a $2.5m deal with SynCardia to collaborate on Emperor total artificial heart tech, launching a multi-stage development program.

item.title: Rio Tinto and Glencore confirm merger talks to form world's largest mining company
item.description: Rio Tinto and Glencore confirm talks on an all-share merger to create the world’s largest mining company, valuing the entity at about US$388B.

item.title: Impact Minerals to test membrane tech in Lake Hope HPA project
item.description: Impact Minerals weighs membrane tech to accelerate Lake Hope HPA, aiming for lower capex/opex, water savings and new SOP/magnesium potash by-products.

item.title: Eastern Metals to fast-track Canadian copper assets after Raptor Resources deal
item.description: EMS surges on Raptor Resources deal, renaming to Raptor Metals and fast-tracking Bathurst copper assets with a $5m raise ahead of Chester drilling.

item.title: ETM appoints Ballard Partners and Cohen & Company for Nasdaq listing
item.description: Energy Transition Minerals hires Ballard Partners for Nasdaq listing push, with Cohen & Company as US adviser to access capital and critical minerals demand.

item.title: Codan Forecasts 52% NPAT Lift on Strong Gold Detector Demand
item.description: Codan rides gold-exploration boom; H1 FY26 revenue forecast ~$394m, NPAT up ~52% to at least $70m, metal detector sales up 46%, led by Minelab.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: Markets edge as Rio-Glencore talks spark change in mining bid
item.description: Rio Tinto slides 6% on Glencore all-stock merger talks; BlueScope up 2% after rejecting a $30 offer. ASX 200 drifts -0.1% as deal news dominates.
